cards.back:
A plain word for speaking.
Bahasa Indonesia: berkata
Example: I say we start the experiment now, before the bell rings.
cards.say: say. I say we start the experiment now, before the bell rings.

cards.back:
To say something firmly and clearly.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyatakan
Example: The captain declared that the match would go ahead.
cards.say: declare. The captain declared that the match would go ahead.

cards.back:
To speak in a quiet, low voice.
Bahasa Indonesia: bergumam
Example: He murmured an answer, but I could not hear it.
cards.say: murmur. He murmured an answer, but I could not hear it.

cards.back:
To say something suddenly in surprise.
Bahasa Indonesia: berseru
Example: She exclaimed with delight when she saw the cake.
cards.say: exclaim. She exclaimed with delight when she saw the cake.

cards.back:
To answer.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjawab
Example: I will reply to your letter by the end of the week.
cards.say: reply. I will reply to your letter by the end of the week.

cards.back:
To answer quickly and sharply.
Bahasa Indonesia: membalas dengan tajam
Example: He retorted that it was not his fault.
cards.say: retort. He retorted that it was not his fault.

cards.back:
Pleasing to look at in a gentle way.
Bahasa Indonesia: cantik
Example: She wore a pretty dress with a small flower print.
cards.say: pretty. She wore a pretty dress with a small flower print.

cards.back:
So beautiful that it surprises you.
Bahasa Indonesia: memukau
Example: The stunning view from the hill made us gasp.
cards.say: stunning. The stunning view from the hill made us gasp.

cards.back:
Unhappy.
Bahasa Indonesia: sedih
Example: The sad child sat alone near the gate.
cards.say: sad. The sad child sat alone near the gate.

cards.back:
Very unhappy and uncomfortable.
Bahasa Indonesia: sengsara
Example: The cold, wet hikers felt miserable all night.
cards.say: miserable. The cold, wet hikers felt miserable all night.

cards.back:
Feeling strong displeasure.
Bahasa Indonesia: marah
Example: The coach was angry about the late arrival.
cards.say: angry. The coach was angry about the late arrival.

cards.back:
Slightly angry or annoyed.
Bahasa Indonesia: jengkel
Example: He felt irritated by the noisy tap in the kitchen.
cards.say: irritated. He felt irritated by the noisy tap in the kitchen.

cards.back:
Extremely angry.
Bahasa Indonesia: murka
Example: The enraged bull ran across the field towards the gate.
cards.say: enraged. The enraged bull ran across the field towards the gate.

cards.back:
Nervous with other people.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemalu
Example: The shy boy only smiled at the visitors.
cards.say: shy. The shy boy only smiled at the visitors.

cards.back:
Easily frightened and lacking courage.
Bahasa Indonesia: penakut
Example: The timid rabbit stayed hidden in the bush.
cards.say: timid. The timid rabbit stayed hidden in the bush.

cards.back:
Not afraid of danger.
Bahasa Indonesia: berani
Example: A brave dog pulled the child from the water.
cards.say: brave. A brave dog pulled the child from the water.

cards.back:
Showing great courage like a hero.
Bahasa Indonesia: heroik
Example: The firefighter made a heroic rescue from the burning house.
cards.say: heroic. The firefighter made a heroic rescue from the burning house.

cards.back:
Having lived or existed for many years.
Bahasa Indonesia: tua
Example: The old oak tree stands in the centre of the village.
cards.say: old. The old oak tree stands in the centre of the village.

cards.back:
A polite word for an old person.
Bahasa Indonesia: lanjut usia
Example: We helped an elderly man cross the busy road.
cards.say: elderly. We helped an elderly man cross the busy road.

cards.back:
Valuable because it is very old.
Bahasa Indonesia: barang antik
Example: The antique clock still works perfectly after two hundred years.
cards.say: antique. The antique clock still works perfectly after two hundred years.

cards.back:
Making you laugh.
Bahasa Indonesia: lucu
Example: The funny story made the whole class laugh.
cards.say: funny. The funny story made the whole class laugh.

cards.back:
Extremely funny.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat lucu
Example: The hilarious film made us laugh until we cried.
cards.say: hilarious. The hilarious film made us laugh until we cried.
